summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive unit tests for glob matching, rule loading, and label assignment logic. Workflow structure tests are complete and end-to-end validation via act is implemented. Strengths: clear test organization with proper BeforeAll/AfterAll lifecycle, thorough error-handling verification (file not found, invalid JSON, missing fields), strong glob pattern coverage (8 test cases), and good exclusive-group priority resolution testing. Gaps: ConvertTo-GlobRegex barely tested (only anchoring verified, not actual regex conversion), limited edge case coverage (no tests for empty labels arrays, special characters in paths, null priority/exclusiveGroup fields, invalid patterns, very large inputs), and only 3 act test cases that don't exercise all scenarios tested in unit tests (e.g., exclusive groups with multiple rules at same priority). Tests would reliably catch major regressions in core logic and pipeline structure but might miss subtle boundary-condition bugs. Test design follows Pester conventions cleanly with good fixture isolation and helper functions, though some describe blocks are dense and could be split for readability.
